example.title: Farm silo at Hill Farm Inn (night view)

brief: Concrete stave silo about 16 ft across and 55 ft high photographed at night under stars (the photo's blue cast is lighting, not paint): pale grey staves in a regular grid, one band of alternating light and dark staves about a quarter of the way up, a segmented galvanized steel dome roof with a small dormer hatch, a caged steel ladder beside the door column and a thin unloader pipe running full height. Give it daylight colors: weathered grey staves, dull galvanized dome.
